description:
Applying a template surfaces unmet repository prerequisites one failure at a time, so adopting a template takes as many attempts as it has unsatisfied requirements.

## Background

The `plan` template requires four separate repository declarations: the `planning` and `breakdown` types in `[type_hierarchy]`, the `brackets` label namespace in `[namespaces]`, four gate keys in the gate registry, and the `dev/active` documentation area in `[documentation] issue_scoped_areas`. Each surfaces only after the previous one is satisfied, and no error names the full set.

The documentation-area requirement is the least discoverable, because it follows from a node's `doc_area` rather than from anything named in the template's own prose. Its message is clear once it fires, but nothing states beforehand that the documentation-area registry is a prerequisite of applying a template at all.

Template application already validates the template's internal consistency up front, rejecting nodes, anchor edges and transforms that name undeclared roles. Repository prerequisites are not checked in that pass.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Applying a template whose repository prerequisites are unmet reports every unmet requirement in one failure.
- [hard] REQ-02: The report distinguishes the kind of each unmet requirement, covering at least declared types, label namespaces, gate keys, and documentation areas.
- [hard] REQ-03: A template whose prerequisites are all satisfied applies without the check changing the resulting graph.
- [hard] REQ-04: The requirement set is derived from the template's own declarations rather than from a hardcoded list for any particular template.
- [hard] REQ-05: The unmet requirements are available structurally in `--json` output.
- [hard] REQ-06: Tests cover a template with several unmet requirement kinds at once, and a template whose prerequisites are satisfied.

## Notes

REQ-04 keeps the check a mechanism over whatever a template declares, so it produces nothing for a template that requires nothing.

Reported from an adopter applying the plan template by hand in a repository that had none of the four declarations. The serial failures are individually clear; the cost is the number of rounds.
title: Template application reports unmet repository prerequisites one failure at a time
